procedures.title: Horizontal Windlass Model Identification
steps: First digits (7/10/15) indicate power rating in hundreds of watts
Suffix DB indicates dual direction with bronze gypsy
procedures.expected_outcome: Correct identification of windlass model and specifications

procedures.title: Power Rating Identification
steps: Identify power rating from model number
procedures.expected_outcome: Correct identification of windlass power rating

procedures.title: Windlass Installation
preconditions: Upper and lower deck surfaces should be parallel
No obstacles under deck for cable/rope/chain passage
Sufficient peak depth to prevent jamming
steps: Establish ideal position with gypsy aligned with bow roller
Use drilling template to drill four holes
Remove excess material from chain through hole
Apply medium grade locking product to thread of stud bolts
Screw stud bolts (short threaded end) onto base
Fix windlass by screwing nuts onto fixing studs
Apply silicone around outside edge of base for watertight seal
Connect supply cables from windlass to battery
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly mounted and sealed windlass installation

procedures.title: Pre-Navigation Safety Procedure
steps: Secure chain with additional device before navigation
Isolate windlass from power system (switch circuit breaker off)
Lock chain to fixed point on boat
procedures.expected_outcome: Safely secured anchor system during navigation

procedures.title: Post-Anchoring Security Procedure
steps: Secure chain or rope to fixed points
Use chain stopper or bollard as securing point

procedures.title: How to Identify Windlass Model Code
steps: Identify gypsy/drum configuration (-=gypsy DX, D=drum SX/gypsy DX, DB=gypsy and drum DX)
procedures.expected_outcome: Correct identification of windlass model specifications

procedures.title: Cable Size Selection
steps: For lengths under 20m, use minimum cable size:
For lengths over 20m, increase cable size accordingly
procedures.expected_outcome: Correct cable size selected for installation

procedures.title: Circuit Breaker Selection
steps: Ensure breaker is rated for DC current
Verify breaker has delayed-action (thermal-magnetic or hydraulic-magnetic)
procedures.expected_outcome: Correct circuit breaker installed for protection

procedures.title: Electrical Connection Setup
preconditions: Components must be within cable length reach
steps: Connect white wire from chain counter sensor cable
Connect green wire from chain counter sensor cable
Connect black wire from chain counter sensor cable
Connect L1 blue wire to circuit breaker
Connect L2 and L3 wires according to diagram
Install hydraulic-magnetic circuit breaker (refer to table on page 10)
Install fuse: 4A for 12V systems or 2A for 24V systems
Connect battery ensuring L = L1 + L2 + L3
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly wired windlass system with all accessories connected

procedures.title: Remote Control System Installation
steps: Mount watertight hand held windlass control
Install radio receiver for remote controls
procedures.expected_outcome: Fully functional remote control system for windlass operation

procedures.title: Annual Gypsy Disassembly
preconditions: Ensure electrical power to motor is switched off
steps: Loosen the fixing screws (30) of the rope/chain stripper (29)
Leave pin, spring and handle in place
procedures.expected_outcome: Gypsy side completely disassembled for maintenance

procedures.title: Annual Drum Disassembly
preconditions: Ensure electrical power to motor is switched off
steps: Use handle (22) to release the bush (2)
procedures.expected_outcome: Drum side completely disassembled for maintenance

procedures.title: Post-Disassembly Maintenance
steps: Clean all removed parts to prevent corrosion
Apply marine grease to shaft thread (14, 15 or 16)
Apply marine grease to gypsy (18) where clutch cones rest (17 and 19)

procedures.title: Regular Salt Deposit Removal
steps: Ensure all salt deposits are removed
procedures.expected_outcome: Windlass free from corrosive salt deposits

procedures.title: Safety Warnings
steps: Stay clear of chains, ropes and gypsy
Ensure electric motor is off during manual operation
Do not operate windlass electrically when handle is inserted
Install appropriate circuit breaker/fuse for motor protection

procedures.title: Clutch Operation
steps: Insert handle (22) into bush (2) of gypsy cover (20)

procedures.title: Weighing Anchor - Electric Operation
steps: If windlass stops, wait few seconds before retrying
If circuit breaker trips, reset and wait few minutes
If blocked, move boat to release anchor
Monitor chain movement for last few meters

procedures.title: Casting Anchor - Manual Operation
steps: Turn handle clockwise to slow chain descent
Secure chain or rope once anchored

procedures.title: Casting Anchor - Electric Operation
steps: Secure chain or rope once anchored

procedures.title: Drum Operation
preconditions: Anchor and rope/chain secured to bitt
steps: Release clutch with handle (minimum 2 turns anticlockwise)
Remove handle from gypsy cover bush
Activate windlass control while maintaining rope tension
Adjust tension to modify winding speed

procedures.title: Manual Anchor Weighing
steps: Unscrew bush minimum 2 turns with lever
Fit lever into gypsy cover seat
Take up chain by moving lever anticlockwise
Release gypsy using lock lever control

procedures.title: Gypsy Replacement Procedure
steps: Install new gypsy (8mm/5/16" or 10mm as needed)

procedures.title: Motor Installation
steps: Select appropriate motor (parts #52A-52F based on voltage/power requirements)
